title: WPCRL/80/2014 of Mahendra Singh Vs State Of Uttarakhand AND OTHERS

paras.text:
WPCRL No.80 of 2014
Honíble Servesh Kumar Gupta, J.

Mr. M.K. Goyal, Advocate, for the
petitioner.
Mr. K.S.Rautela, A.G.A. with Mr.
Amit Kapri, Brief Holder for the State.
Having perused the pleadings made
in the petition, it reveals that it is
engrossed with a number of precedents of
Honíble the Apex Court as well as of the
High Court. This amounts to mounting
mental pressure upon the Court for a
favorable order, which is against the rules
and cannot be encouraged. The writ
petition as well as interim relief
application stands dismissed.
Registry is directed to return the
petition with permission and liberty to the
petitioner for filing fresh petition after
removing the defects.
Urgency application stands disposed
of.

(Servesh Kumar Gupta, J.)
 Vacation Judge
 28.01.2014
N.P./Arpan
